To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

consumer involvement in the design and implementation of health services research is a powerful way of improving the quality and relevance of the research, and that it can also be an effective way of ensuring that the research findings are translated into policy and practice.

the inclusion of health consumers in the design and implementation of a health services research project, and in the analysis of data and the write-up of the findings, can enhance the contribution of consumers to the research process.

the inclusion of consumers in health services research can lead to innovative approaches to research, and that the inclusion of health consumers can be a valuable and effective way of conducting research that is relevant to consumers and can lead to better health services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing and evaluating strategies to enhance consumer-driven research and the impact this has on health service research and its translation to policy and practice.
the development and evaluation of a novel and inclusive research approach that is driven by the perspectives and needs of health consumers.
how to engage consumers meaningfully in health services research, and how to maximise their contribution to the research process and its outcomes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the involvement of consumers in the research process was essential for the success of the project.
consumer-driven research is a powerful tool that can enhance the quality of health services research and the translation of research findings into policy and practice.
consumer-driven research is a powerful tool to improve health services research, its translation into effective policies, and its implementation in the real world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
consumer involvement is a powerful tool to ensure that research is relevant and has the greatest potential for translation into policy and practice.
consumer-driven research is a valuable tool to enhance health research and its translation.
consumer-driven research is not just a nice-to-have but is a necessity for the future of health services research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
inclusive research is an important strategy to ensure that health research meets the needs of the people it serves.
consumer-driven research is an effective strategy to enhance research quality and the translation of research into practice.
consumers are not passive recipients but are active agents in health research.
